name: Nishiarita (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nishiarita town emblem in white: a stylised device of an arc above two hooked strokes, like a letter S.
history: Flag of the former town of Nishiarita in Saga Prefecture, dissolved on 2006-03-01.

features.role: Nishiarita town emblem — a stylised device of an arc above two hooked strokes, like a letter S
